title: Integrate a removable Gaussian cost before estimating thermal energy
statement: At n,n, Z=exp(4beta|U2|n²/M) Eperp|h_n(Bperp)|². For raw Gaussian importance integration, Rraw=exp(8beta|U2|n²/M) Rperp where R=EW²/(EW)². The first thermal ratio estimator has second moment<=4 Eperp|partial_beta h_n|²/Eperp|h_n|²<infinity at finite M,n,L.
